templar.title: Templar notes
items: Line up {Divine Toll} → {Hammer of Light} with big trash pulls and add phases
Keep SotR up even while bursting. Key tank busters: {busters}

lightsmith.title: Lightsmith notes
items: When to put {Holy Bulwark} on yourself: {busters}
During add or AoE damage phases, put {Holy Bulwark} on the healer or a squishy ally
Line up {Sacred Weapon} with big trash pulls and add phases

Rav'i: [탱버] Keep SotR up for Hydrastrike; if your health is low, use Ardent Defender or Guardian of Ancient Kings
[해제] Cleanse the disease debuff from party members hit by Regurgitate with Cleanse Toxins
[참고] During Ssscavenging AoE damage, prop up endangered party members with Word of Glory
[위치] If the empty pile is far, use Divine Steed to move fast and drag the boss over
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Assign Rebuke and Avenger's Shield to separate slots in the Toxic Atrophy interrupt rotation
[차단] During Uncoil, delay the Writhe's Toxic Atrophy casts with Hammer of Justice or Blinding Light
[위치] During Death Rattle, get away fast with Divine Steed to break the Vine Grip tether
[참고] Use Divine Toll at the start of Uncoil to focus damage on the gathered Writhes
Zul'jan: [탱버] Have SotR up for Chop Down; if your health is low, use Ardent Defender or Guardian of Ancient Kings
[참고] Join the group in the agreed Boneslicer line to clear your Ritual Venom too; Chop Down only clears 2 stacks
[위치] If your beam spot is far, use Divine Steed to get there before Ritual of the Fang starts
[참고] Support party members with the Boneslicer DoT using Word of Glory

Lightblossom Trinity: [탱버] Keep SotR up right before Bedrock Slam and add Ardent Defender in high keys.
[차단] Interrupt Kezkitt's Light Bolt with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.
[참고] Put Blessing of Protection on an ally with a big Thornblade bleed to block the physical bleed damage.
[참고] When Bedrock Surge and Overgrowth overlap, top up allies with Word of Glory.
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Use Blessing of Freedom on rooted allies, especially the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, to free them from Bloodthorn Roots.
[참고] If the Bloodthirsty Gaze target is about to be caught, block Incise's physical bleed damage with Blessing of Protection.
[탱버] Ardent Defender for Thorncaller Roar; Guardian of Ancient Kings for Thorncaller Roar during Frenzy.
[회피] If the tank is the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, gain distance with Divine Steed.
Lightwarden Ruia: [탱버] Keep SotR up at all times during Bear Form and use Guardian of Ancient Kings when things overlap.
[차단] Interrupt Warden's Wrath with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.
[참고] Heal allies with Grievous Thrash to full with Word of Glory to remove the bleed.
[탱버] After 40%, split Ardent Defender and Guardian of Ancient Kings.
Ziekket: [탱버] Have SotR up before Thornspike to reduce the physical bleed that follows.
[차단] Before the rebirth, interrupt the Lashers' Lightspore Shot with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.
[차단] Before the rebirth, Blinding Light and Hammer of Justice work on the Lashers, so use them to stop casts.
[참고] Top up allies with high Essence stacks using Word of Glory.

The Hoardmonger: [해제] When Toxic Spores stack up, cleanse yourself or the party member with the most stacks using Cleanse Toxins.
[탱버] Ravenous Bellow and Hearty Bellow are armor-ignoring physical, so take them with Ardent Defender.
[위치] Use Divine Steed to reach distant mushrooms and step on them within 12 sec.
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Split interrupts on both Shivercores' Winter's Shroud with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.
[탱버] If you have to take Frozen Tempest outside Snowdrift, pop Ardent Defender.
[위치] If nobody can step on Rimeshatter, the tank steps on it and heals with Word of Glory.
Nalorakk: [탱버] Take Forceful Slam with Guardian of Ancient Kings and Shield of the Righteous up.
[탱버] Take the armor-ignoring 3-hit Overwhelming Onslaught with Ardent Defender.
[위치] If knocked back, return to the Forceful Slam spot quickly with Divine Steed.
[참고] When Spectral Slash or Echoing Fury damage piles up, self-heal with Word of Glory.

Kystia Manaheart: [차단] Throw Avenger's Shield at the Mirror Images to silence several clones, and Rebuke the rest.
[차단] If the clones are grouped, stop Felstorm with Blinding Light or Hammer of Justice.
[해제] Corroding Spittle is magic, so Cleanse Toxins can't remove it. Leave it to the healer.
[탱버] When Chaos Barrage and Mirror Images overlap, add Ardent Defender to SotR.
Zaen Bladesorrow: [해제] Right after Envenom, cleanse Heartstop Poison from yourself with Cleanse Toxins.
[탱버] Stack Ardent Defender with SotR on the Envenom cast.
[회피] If there aren't enough barrels, take a Murder in a Row line with Divine Shield and give the barrel to the party.
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] Every Legion Strike, stack SotR with Guardian of Ancient Kings and Ardent Defender in alternation.
[탱버] When Infernal Crush overlaps with Demonic Rage AoE damage, use Ardent Defender.
[위치] Use Divine Steed to move the boss to the axe quickly.
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Interrupt Chaos Bolt with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.
[차단] Stop Felfire Burst from Wild Imp packs with Avenger's Shield and Blinding Light.
[탱버] Take the Furious Vilefiend's Shadow Bite with SotR up.
[위치] Use Divine Steed to get away from the Infernal and reposition.

Taz'Rah: [탱버] If Void Blast hits hard, alternate Ardent Defender and Guardian of Ancient Kings.
[회피] If knocked back into a puddle, get out immediately with Divine Steed.
[탱버] Right after Dark Bloom, use Word of Glory on low-health party members.
Atroxus: [탱버] Rotate Ardent Defender and Guardian of Ancient Kings for each Hulking Claw.
[회피] If Toxic Creeper is about to catch you, gain distance with Divine Steed.
[탱버] If Hulking Claw drops your health sharply after Sickening Bite, use Lay on Hands.
[해제] Cleanse Mind-Numbing Poison from party members who stepped in Poison Pool with Cleanse Toxins.
Charonus: [탱버] Alternate Ardent Defender and Guardian of Ancient Kings for each Dark Waves.
[해제] Use Blessing of Freedom on DPS with Condensed Mass stacks to clear them.
[탱버] Use Word of Glory on party members whose health dropped from the Cosmic Crash DoT.

The Golden Serpent: [탱버] Keep SotR up when Tail Thrash is cast
[차단] Use Blinding Light or Hammer of Justice on Animated Gold packs heading to the boss
[위치] Reposition quickly with Divine Steed when dragging the boss around the gold piles
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Prioritize Avenger's Shield and Rebuke on the mummies' Wretched Discharge
[참고] Use Word of Glory on the Desiccation target to help them reach 90% health
[위치] During the Entomb coffin search, use Divine Steed to reach the far coffins quickly
The Council of Tribes: [탱버] Right after Backhand, pop Guardian of Ancient Kings and hold; if it's down, kite with Divine Steed
[차단] Assign Avenger's Shield or Rebuke to Poison Nova and make sure it gets interrupted
[해제] If Poison Nova goes off, cleanse the poison immediately with Cleanse Toxins
Dazar, The First King: [탱버] Alternate Guardian of Ancient Kings and Ardent Defender for Savage Maul + Blade Combo
[탱버] For combos with no cooldown available, ask for an external and don't drop SotR
[차단] Assign Avenger's Shield and Rebuke to Reban's Deathly Roar

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] Use Rebuke or Avenger's Shield on Frigid Shard.
[탱버] Have SotR up for any Frigid Shard that doesn't get interrupted.
[해제] When Cold Claws stacks build up, clear them with Blessing of Freedom.
[참고] When Infused Whelps spawn, use Divine Toll to hit several with Avenger's Shield and grab threat.
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Have SotR up before the Searing Blows channel and add Ardent Defender at high stacks.
[차단] Use Rebuke or Avenger's Shield on Blaze Volley.
[참고] If the Searing Wounds fire DoT drains your health, self-heal with Word of Glory.
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [탱버] Have SotR up during the Stormslam cast; if a late dispel lets it stack, use Guardian of Ancient Kings.
[해제] Stormslam is a magic debuff, so Cleanse Toxins can't remove it. Leave it to the healer.
[탱버] Save Ardent Defender and a GoAK charge for the phase 2 transition.

Adderis & Aspix: [탱버] Keep Shield of the Righteous up during Overload and use Ardent Defender when things overlap.
[위치] If Gale Force pushes you far, return with Divine Steed and join the Thunder and Lightning soak.
[탱버] If the Gust target is in danger, help heal them with Word of Glory.
Merektha: [탱버] Time Shield of the Righteous for Lightning Bite and add Ardent Defender in high keys.
[차단] Interrupt the Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Rebuke and Avenger's Shield.
[해제] Cleanse the Poison Spit DoT with Cleanse Toxins.
[위치] When A Knot of Snakes targets group up, free them all at once with Blinding Light.
Galvazzt: [탱버] If you have to block a beam, go in with Guardian of Ancient Kings or Ardent Defender up.
[탱버] If the beam soaker is in danger, save them with Word of Glory or Lay on Hands.
[위치] When Induction Field drops, move the boss to a new spot quickly with Divine Steed.
Avatar of Sethraliss: [탱버] Time Shield of the Righteous for Tainted Strike and use Guardian of Ancient Kings as stacks build.
[차단] Interrupt the Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock with Rebuke and Avenger's Shield.
[위치] Lock down Faithless Tormentors heading for the healer with Blinding Light or Hammer of Justice.
[위치] When a Faithless Tormentor pack comes in, hit several at once with Divine Toll.

6940.m: Talent · 1.4% of base mana · 40 yd range · Instant · 2 min cooldown
6940.d:
Blesses a party or raid member, reducing their damage taken by 30%, but you suffer 100% of damage prevented.
Last 12 sec, or until transferred damage would cause you to fall below 20% health.

26573.d: Consecrates the land beneath you, causing [Burning Crusade: [((5% of Attack Power) * ceil12) * 1.05] Radiant / [((5% of Attack Power) * ceil12) * 1.05] Holy] damage over 12 sec to enemies who enter the area [Consecrated Ground: and reducing their movement speed by 50% / .] Limit 1.

114154.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, [Shield of Vengeance: Shield of Vengeance] [Ardent Defender / Divine Protection], and Lay on Hands by 30%.

204018.m: Talent · 3% of base mana · 40 yd range · Instant · 5 min cooldown · 1 Charge · Requires level 35 (Protection)
204018.d:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.
Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
Shares a cooldown with Blessing of Protection.

204074.d: Avenging Wrath and Sentinel have 50% reduced cooldown and 40% reduced duration.

204077.d: During Divine Shield, all targets within 15 yds are taunted.

389539.d:
Call upon the Light and gain 15 stacks of Divine Resolve, increasing your maximum health by 1% and reducing your damage taken by 2% per stack for 20 sec. After 5.0 sec, you will begin to lose 1 stack per second, but each 3 Holy Power spent will delay the loss of your next stack by 1 sec.
While active, your damage and healing are increased by 10%, and critical strike chance is increased by 10%.

391054.d:
3 Holy Power / 2% of base mana · · 40 yd range
2 sec cast · · 10 min cooldown
Requires Paladin
Requires level 19
Petition the Light on the behalf of a fallen ally, restoring spirit to body and allowing them to reenter battle with 60% health and at least 20% mana.

432459.m: Talent · 40 yd range · Instant · 1 min recharge · 2 Charges
432459.d:
Will the Light to coalesce and become manifest as a Holy Armament, wielded by your friendly target.
Holy Bulwark:
While wielding a Holy Bulwark, gain an absorb shield for 15.0% of your max health and an additional 2.0% every 2 sec. Lasts 20 sec.
Becomes Sacred Weapon after use.

1246481.d: Guardian of Ancient Kings has 1 additional charge.

6940.m: 특성 · 1.4% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
6940.d:
대상 파티원 또는 공격대원을 축복하여 대상이 받는 피해를 30%만큼 감소시키지만, 감소한 피해의 100%를 자신이 입습니다.
12초 동안 또는 이전된 피해로 자신의 생명력이 20% 미만으로 떨어질 때까지 지속됩니다.

26573.d: 자신이 서 있는 땅을 신성화하여 그 지역에 접근하는 적에게 12초에 걸쳐 총 [불타는 성전: [((전투력의 5%) * ceil12) * 1.05]의 광휘 / [((전투력의 5%) * ceil12) * 1.05]의 신성] 피해를 입 [신성한 대지: 히고 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다 / 힙니다.] 효과는 최대 1회만 발동합니다.

114154.d: 천상의 보호막, [복수의 방패: 복수의 방패] [헌신적인 수호자 / 신의 가호], 신의 축복 주문의 재사용 대기시간이 30%만큼 감소합니다.

204018.m: 특성 · 3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능 · 요구 레벨 35 (보호)
204018.d:
대상 파티원 또는 공격대원에게 축복을 내려, 10초 동안 모든 마법 피해 및 해로운 효과에 면역이 되게 합니다.
참을성 상태인 대상에게는 사용할 수 없습니다. 대상은 이후 30초 동안 참을성 상태가 됩니다.
보호의 축복과 재사용 대기시간을 공유합니다.

204074.d: 응징의 격노 및 파수꾼의 재사용 대기시간이 50%만큼, 지속시간은 40%만큼 감소합니다.

204077.d: 천상의 보호막의 지속시간 동안 15미터 내의 모든 대상을 도발합니다.

389539.d:
빛의 힘을 불러내어 신성한 결의 15중첩을 얻습니다. 20초 동안 중첩 하나당 최대 생명력이 1%만큼 증가하고 받는 피해는 2%만큼 감소합니다. 5.0초가 지나면 1초마다 1중첩씩 사라집니다. 단, 신성한 힘 3개를 소모할 때마다 다음 중첩이 1초 늦게 사라집니다.
효과가 활성화된 동안 시전자의 공격력과 치유량이 10%만큼, 치명타 및 극대화율은 10%만큼 증가합니다.

391054.m: 신성한 힘 3개 / 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 10 분 재사용 대기시간
391054.d: 쓰러진 아군을 위해 빛에 읍소하여 영혼을 육신으로 되돌려 60%의 생명력과 20% 이상의 마나를 지닌 상태로 부활시킵니다.

432459.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
432459.d:
의지의 힘으로 빛을 그러모아 신성한 무장으로 실체화한 뒤, 아군 대상이 착용할 수 있도록 합니다.
신성한 보루:
신성한 보루를 사용 중일 때 최대 생명력의 15.0%에 해당하는 피해 흡수 보호막을 얻고 2초마다 피해 흡수량이 2.0%만큼 증가합니다. 20초 동안 지속됩니다.
사용 후 신성한 무기가 됩니다.

altar/Rav'i.2: [탱버] Hydrastrike is big physical damage from 3 heads in a row, so have SotR up early

altar/The Writhing Coil.0: [탱버] Tail Scythe is big physical damage plus a small knockback, so have SotR up before the cast

altar/Zul'jan.0: [탱버] Chop Down is a big 2-hit physical combo, so have SotR up before the cast

murder/Kystia Manaheart.2: [탱버] The tank takes the first Chaos Barrage hit, so keep SotR up.

murder/Zaen Bladesorrow.0: [탱버] Use SotR together with a defensive on the Envenom cast.

voidscar/Taz'Rah.0: [탱버] Keep SotR up for every Void Blast (2 sec cast, big shadow damage + knockback).

voidscar/Atroxus.0: [탱버] Have SotR up before the Hulking Claw cast and call for a defensive or a healer external if needed.

voidscar/Charonus.0: [탱버] Save SotR and a defensive for Dark Waves (5 sec cast, big shadow frontal).

kings/The Golden Serpent.0: [탱버] Have SotR up for every Tail Thrash. Method rates this ability as low danger
